result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant name and one partially cut-off restaurant card.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off — both the image and the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' are truncated, indicating a layout overflow issue.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container properly clips and indicates scrollability (e.g., with a visible scroll affordance or fade effect), and make sure restaurant names truncate gracefully with an ellipsis rather than being hard-cut.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word in the 'Fastest near you' section, making it unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with ellipsis (text-overflow: ellipsis) so the name reads 'Trattoria Piccol...' in a controlled manner, or widen the card to accommodate the full name.
